दैशिक दैशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. देश), belong-
ing or relating to a place, local, provincial; relating
or having reference to space; belonging to a country,
national; produced in any place or country; acquainted
with any place or country; teaching, directing, show-
ing, pointing out [cf. देशिक and देश्य]; (अस्), m.
a guide; a teacher.

दैष्टिक दैष्टिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. दिष्ट), fated,
predestined; (अस्), m. a predestinarian, a fatalist.
—दैष्टिक-ता, f. or दैष्टिक-त्व, अम्, n. fatalism,
predestinarianism.
